core_accelerators.what: The leftovers that ultra-accelerate. We stand on these. They are the 1s and 0s and nulls.

linux.what: THE substrate. Everything runs on this.

rust.what: THE language. Zero unsafe in application code.

wgpu.what: WebGPU for Rust. Our GPU pipeline.

naga.what: Shader compiler. Part of wgpu. Translates our WGSL.

vulkan.what: GPU API. Vendor-agnostic. The hardware contract.

wireguard.what: Mesh encryption. kernel module. Millions of users.

zola.what: Static site generator. sporePrint built with this.

flate2.what: Our ONLY runtime dependency. Compression. That's it.

core_accelerators.acceleration_model: 249,573 inner entities × 185,900 core stars = the core leftovers MULTIPLY our output. One dependency (flate2). Everything else is pure Rust on pure Linux on pure Vulkan. The leftovers ARE the acceleration.
